pages.title: Метеоритный взлет
pages.notes: Now that you have a $(item)Mana Pool$() and the ability to fill it with $(item)Mana$(), you can use the pool to produce magical resources like the $(item)Mana Diamond$().$(br2)We know that it's a resource that the $(item)Old Gods$() covet. You should sacrifice a $(item)Block of Mana Diamond$() and see what happens.

pages.text: Usually such a ritual will yield you a bounty of rare earth metals. With the $(item)Ritual Diviner (Dusk)$() you need to set the current ritual to $(item)Mark of the Falling Tower$().$(br2)This ritual in particular you want to keep away from your base of operations. It is very $(item)Volatile$().$(br2)This ritual consumes $(item)1 Million LP$() from your blood network.

To start this advanced ritual, craft an $(item)Awakened Activation Crystal$() from the runes you made in the previous chapter.$(br2)After you have started the ritual, drop the $(item)Block of Mana Diamond$() on top the $(item)Master Ritual Stone$() in the center of the ritual, then head for the hills.

The $(item)Digital Agonizer$() can help you achieving the goal of charging a $(item)Master Blood Orb$() with the $(item)1 Million LP$() required for the ritual.$(br2)It fills linked $(item)Blood Altars$() with $(item)LP$() using $(item)Data Models$().
An $(item)Altar Linker$() can link the $(item)Digital Agonizer$() to an altar. Only one $(item)Digital Agonizer$() can be linked to each altar.

pages.title: LP Alternatives
pages.text: If you want a more sinister alternative to the $(item)Digital Agonizer$(), you can use a $(item)Well of Suffering$() ritual instead.$(br2)You should be getting used to getting your hands dirty though. There's some unsavory work coming your way
